description: Generate accurate APA 7th or 6th edition references and parenthetical/narrative in-text citations from structured source fields, a batch list (up to 500 sources), BibTeX or RIS. Supports websites, journal articles, books, book chapters, videos, newspapers, reports and podcasts; handles 20+ authors, corporate authors, automatic sentence case, DOI normalization, alphabetical sorting with 2024a/2024b disambiguation, and optional APA-formatted Word (.docx) output with 0.5-inch hanging indents. 0 AI, deterministic, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.001/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/apa-citation-generator.
